title: Tamper Detection Engine — Final Client-Side Hardening
tier: Client-Side Defensive Warfare Tier 3 — Maximum without backend

architecture.pattern: Cross-validated signals → multiplicative + additive scoring → shadow amplification → fragmented persistent state → delayed triggers → dynamic integrity verification → distributed micro-checks → sentinel redundancy → camouflaged degradation + false recovery loops → backend bridge ready
architecture.persistence: Fragmented: SQLite app_state (key: __tds_v3) + SecureStore (key: __qm_shard) — missing shard = implicit suspicion
architecture.entropy: Counter + timestamp mixed via LCG — non-deterministic, non-Math.random, non-repeating
architecture.stealth: No alerts, no locks, no console output in production
architecture.redundancy: Sentinel + distributed micro-checks operate independently — detect anomalies even if main engine is disabled
architecture.integrity: Dynamic tokens evolve each heartbeat epoch — no fixed signature to patch
architecture.backend_hook: securityBridge.ts — no-op stub, zero-refactor activation when server connected

MOVE_1_dynamic_integrity_core.description: Runtime-generated integrity tokens that evolve each heartbeat — moving target, no fixed signature

implementation.sessionAnchor: Derived from launch timestamp via XOR-shift mixing
implementation.verification: Recomputed dynamically at each integrity check — no stored magic value

MOVE_1_dynamic_integrity_core.improvement_over_phase14: Static INTEGRITY_MAGIC (0x5F3759DF) replaced with session-unique evolving token

MOVE_2_distributed_micro_checks.description: Tiny validators embedded in AI handlers, premium gate, navigation — no single check decisive
micro_checks: microCheckTiming(callSiteLabel) — detects clock manipulation, spoofed AI latency (<50ms response)
microCheckStateCoherence() — verifies sentinel state wasn't deleted/zeroed
microCheckEntropy() — verifies internal entropy seed hasn't been externally mutated
MOVE_2_distributed_micro_checks.risk_contribution: 2-8 pts each — invisible individually, combined = system integrity
MOVE_2_distributed_micro_checks.integration: aiProvider.ts (timing), PremiumGate.tsx (state coherence), exported for future nav integration

MOVE_3_state_fragmentation.description: Persisted state split across multiple storage keys — attacker must find and patch all shards
shards: SQLite __tds_v3: main risk score, degradation day, pending penalties, recovery phase
SecureStore __qm_shard: critical shadow flags (encrypted by OS), false recovery state
In-memory volatile: session anchor, integrity seed/epoch, live counters
MOVE_3_state_fragmentation.missing_shard_penalty: +5-8 pts suspicion when shard is corrupted or missing after first session
MOVE_3_state_fragmentation.reconstruction: Runtime merge: OR for sticky flags, latest-wins for counters

MOVE_4_degradation_camouflage.description: Corruption patterns blend with natural AI imperfection — user thinks 'AI is having an off day'
strategies: Semantic drift — swap domain terms for plausible synonyms (sets→rounds, reps→repetitions)
Soft truncation — end at natural sentence boundary at 60-75% (less aggressive than Phase 14)
Formatting inconsistency — randomly convert some bullets, remove some bold (not all)
Filler injection — append generic closing that dilutes quality
Network-simulation delays — jitter patterns that mimic DNS/SSL/response latency variance
MOVE_4_degradation_camouflage.improvement_over_phase14: Replaced aggressive truncation (30-50%) and total format stripping with subtle, plausible imperfections

MOVE_5_false_recovery_loop.description: After HIGH risk, temporarily reduce apparent risk (cooling phase) — attacker thinks fix worked, then tighter penalties snap back

implementation.cooling_window: 3 minutes of apparent relief (score dropped to MEDIUM range)
implementation.reapply: Score restored to pre-recovery + 15 bonus points
implementation.persistence: Recovery phase persisted across shards for cross-session continuity (resets on 1hr+ gap)

MOVE_6_shadow_escalation_cap.description: Hard ceilings on all degradation metrics — app remains usable, broken app = investigation trigger
MOVE_6_shadow_escalation_cap.rationale: Fully broken app triggers investigation → detection. Partially degraded creates sustainable doubt.

MOVE_7_kill_switch_readiness.description: Backend hook stub — zero-refactor activation when server authority is available

api.querySecurityBridge(): Returns server-issued risk overrides, forced flags, entitlement truth (currently no-op)
api.receiveBridgeDirective(input): Entry point for server authority injection

MOVE_7_kill_switch_readiness.integration: tamperEngine.evaluate() consults bridge after scoring — server overrides take precedence

risk_model.type: asymmetric — multiplicative for critical + integrity rules, additive for signals, amplified by shadow flags, delayed triggers, false recovery loops
risk_model.decay: 5 points per 5 min in-session (reduced by shadow flags, can reach 0 with integrity violations), 5 points per hour offline
risk_model.floor: Score ≥ 10 if tamper flags set, ≥ 20 if integrity/tripwire flags set
risk_model.ceiling: AI delay max 2.5s, failure rate max 65%, fallback rate max 65%, premium reduction max 60%
risk_model.gaming_prevention: Critical rules force score to MEDIUM floor + multiply. Delayed triggers prevent timing analysis. Sentinel provides backup detection. False recovery wastes attacker debugging time.

After grace: TELEMETRY_SILENCE(25) + DEAD_SIGNALS(20) × shadow amp → MEDIUM → camouflaged delay + fallback. Sentinel + micro-checks also detect independently.
PREMIUM_BYPASS(×1.8+15) + sentinel + micro-check state coherence → HIGH instantly. Grace does NOT protect critical rules.
Sentinel detects frozen heartbeat → sentinelShouldDegrade() fires → degradation escalates via effectiveRisk(). Delayed integrity penalty queued. Dynamic token mismatch on next check.
